scope.repositories_reviewed: all repositories visible to the linked GitHub account during the 2026-09-19 portfolio sweep
scope.goal: Identify Hawkar/JANUS mechanisms that can materially improve U-PAIR/TRUMP after known public prior art is removed, while quarantining upstream-derived, creative, domain-specific and heuristic mechanisms from proof authority.

central_finding.statement: The strongest JANUS-specific candidate is not a new Boolean representation language. It is a debt-aware exact synthesis architecture that distinguishes reversible re-encoding from irreversible semantic projection, records unresolved witness obligations as existential debt, and permits debt discharge only through independently checkable local witness/Skolem proof objects.
central_finding.why_it_matters_now: V1.1 is already polynomially equivalent to ordinary Boolean circuits as a representation language, so the remaining frontier is uniform discovery and certification of compact witness circuits rather than their mere existence.

tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.name: QUOTIENTED_ANTI_ALIAS_SEMANTIC_PROGRESS
core: Exact bijective definitional re-encodings are normalization inside one quotient class and claim zero semantic progress.
A progress measure invariant under exact reversible reparameterization cannot strictly decrease around an invertible re-encoding cycle.
Strict progress is reserved for certified irreversible semantic transitions.
tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.algorithmic_use: Prevents a synthesis engine from faking progress by renaming variables, changing XOR bases, DAG refactoring or reintroducing equivalent state under aliases.

tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.name: LOCAL_IRREVERSIBILITY_COLLISION_CERTIFICATE
tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.meaning: A locally checkable witness that a proposed quotient/projection merges two semantically distinct old continuation states; impossible for a bijective normalization.
tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.algorithmic_use: Acts as a negative certificate for unsafe projection and can guide a search engine away from lossy eliminations without enumerating the entire residual relation.

tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.name: EXISTENTIAL_DEBT_LEDGER
core: Eliminating an unresolved original semantic bit without a checked witness-selection rule moves one unit from live state into existential debt rather than claiming progress.
Renaming, reversible basis change, DAG refactoring and fresh aliases cannot discharge debt.
Debt can be discharged only by a polynomial-size independently checked witness/Skolem rule or a certified terminal argument that the choice is irrelevant.
A valid terminal requires zero live original semantic bits and zero undischarged debt; SAT reconstructs an original witness.
tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.algorithmic_use: Turns witness reconstruction from an afterthought into a conserved obligation during projection/elimination.

tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.name: DOMAIN_PLUS_WITNESS_PLUS_PROOF_INTERFACE
origins: Janus-Fundamentum U-PAIR-1J shielding bridge and later hostile lineages
tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.core: Pi=(D,f,pi_D,pi_f), where D is the exact projected domain, f is a conditional witness on D, and both domain and witness obligations are independently checked.
tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.algorithmic_use: Prevents a solver from silently totalizing partial relations or treating successful witness generation on sampled inputs as proof of the exact domain.

tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.name: TYPED_CANONICAL_BOUNDARY_RECEIPTS_AND_QUOTIENT_CARRIERS
core: Choose exact carrier types according to the semantic algebra instead of forcing every interface into a truth table.
Examples include affine syndrome quotients, logarithmic raw conditioning, factorized independent components and candidate 2CNF implication-closure carriers.
Every carrier has separate identity, derivation, adequacy, reconstruction, replay and lifecycle obligations.
tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.algorithmic_use: Provides a front-end compiler that can reduce source structure into exact typed interfaces before debt-aware witness synthesis.

tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.name: BICAMERAL_EXACT_DECOMPOSITION_PORTFOLIO
core: Canonical polynomial structural discovery first.
Enumerate separator assignments only after an explicit logarithmic/constant branch budget gate.
Solve leaves only with already sealed exact carriers.
Reconstruct one root witness and replay it on the unchanged source; UNSAT requires exhaustive exact branch rejection.
tier_1_algorithmic_mechanisms.algorithmic_use: Exact structural compiler/solver lane for tractable decomposable regions; returns OPEN outside scope instead of contaminating the global algorithm.

tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.name: ORIGIN_PRIME_SAFE_ROUTE_REUSE
core: Cache exact formula-bound discovery routes, not verdict authority.
Revalidate separator/component route on the current canonical source before reuse.
Recheck cached SAT witness on the current formula.
Never reuse cached UNSAT as a verdict shortcut.
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.integration: Content-addressed proof-route cache for repeated normalized subproblems in U-PAIR.
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.novelty_note: Memoization is established; the valuable JANUS part is the strict authority separation and revalidation discipline.

tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.name: IMMUTABLE_TRUTH_CORE_PLUS_LEARNABLE_POLICY
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.core: Learning may choose only among pre-authorized safe actions while exact semantics, verifier, identity/provenance and acceptance rules remain immutable.
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.integration: Allow ML/heuristic policy to choose decomposition order, rule family, carrier, branch candidate or specialist while a deterministic verifier remains the only authority.
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.novelty_note: Solver portfolios and ML-guided SAT search are established; the useful contribution is the governance boundary when combined with proof-carrying debt discharge.

tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.name: SPECIALIST_SWARM_WITH_PROOF_ROOT_COLLAPSE
core: Multiple specialists may independently propose decompositions, invariants, counterexamples or witness rules.
Duplicate derivations collapse to the same proof/provenance root rather than being counted as independent evidence.
Disagreement remains visible and unresolved branches may continue without majority-vote truth promotion.
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.integration: Parallel proposal layer over a single deterministic proof checker.
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.novelty_note: Multi-agent/portfolio search is known; source-root collapse plus proof-authority separation is a JANUS-specific orchestration discipline.

tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.name: SELF_TESTED_ACCELERATION_AND_SHADOW_PROMOTION
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.core: A new fast path must first agree with a trusted reference path, benchmark in shadow mode, promote only after equivalence checks, periodically cross-check, and fall back on mismatch.
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.integration: Use when replacing expensive exact carrier construction/verifier steps with optimized implementations.

tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.name: FAIL_CLOSED_MACHINE_READABLE_RESEARCH_COMPILER
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.core: Machine-readable algorithms carry explicit operators/invariants; unknown operators return OPEN and natural-language metadata has no execution/proof authority.
tier_2_cross_repo_mechanisms.integration: Candidate format for a portable U-PAIR proof/search IR consumed by multiple specialists and an independent checker.

proposed_integrated_architecture.name: JANUS_PROOF_CARRYING_SYNTHESIS_SPIRAL_V2_CANDIDATE

authority_split.learnable_or_heuristic_layer: May rank/select legal candidate transformations, specialists, decomposition routes and search order.
authority_split.immutable_exact_layer: Defines semantics, debt transitions, rule admissibility, domain obligations, source identity and final verification.

proposed_integrated_architecture.why_this_targets_the_current_frontier: The Boolean representation language is already circuit-complete. The open engineering/theory problem is how to uniformly discover and certify useful compact witness circuits from source relations without hiding solver work inside aliases, generic validity or exponential search.

highest_priority_formalization.name: V1_1_PROJECTED_SEMANTIC_DEBT_KERNEL
highest_priority_formalization.state: (canonical source F, live projected interface B, exact domain object D, witness/proof DAG P, debt ledger Delta, reversible quotient class q, route-cache references)
legal_macrosteps: REVERSIBLE_NORMALIZE: exact bijection; q may change representative; Delta unchanged; no progress claim.
PROJECT: eliminate semantics exactly; unresolved reconstruction obligation is transferred into Delta.
DISCHARGE: remove debt only with a frozen locally checkable witness/Skolem derivation or certified irrelevance.
DECOMPOSE: split into exact independent/typed carriers only with a proved recomposition contract.
TERMINATE: TRUE/FALSE only when all exact domain obligations close and Delta=0; SAT reconstructs/replays original witness.
highest_priority_formalization.scheduler_contract: A learned/portfolio scheduler may choose which legal macrostep to attempt, but cannot change the macrostep verifier or debt accounting.
comparison_targets: certified projected knowledge compilation / D4-style pipelines
modern SAT/QBF portfolio and ML-guided solvers
